name: North Dakota Secretary of State Contractor Search
updateFrequency: unknown; verify against the official contractor search before relying on freshness assumptions
licenseTypesIncluded: North Dakota contractor license records exposed by Secretary of State contractor search
knownExclusions: Specialty trade boards, local permits, business registration details, and non-Secretary-of-State authorizations require separate sources where available.
Electrical, plumbing, asbestos, and water-well/geothermal credentials are represented separately where official statewide sources were identified.
Complaint and enforcement information may require separate official pages or requests.
rateLimitNotes: No adapter is implemented. Do not automate portal access unless access terms and technical controls are reviewed.
publicRecordsNotes: Official Secretary of State contractor-search metadata only. Absence from this source is not proof that a license, registration, or local authorization does not exist elsewhere.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: No official bulk download has been confirmed in this phase.
researchNotes: Registry-only blocked source for North Dakota Secretary of State contractor licensing. The Secretary of State states that a contractor license is required when the cost, value, or price of a job exceeds $4,000, including subcontractors, general contractors, public contractors, and nonresident contractors.
verificationCaveats: This source covers North Dakota Secretary of State contractor licensing only.
The license class is based on maximum project value and does not replace separate trade-board credentials, local permits, or other agency authorizations.
No matching record means no match in the checked source at the checked time, not proof that another board, local license, permit, or related record does not exist.
verificationNotes: No supported sync or verification adapter is exposed while the interactive FirstStop search contract and allowed reuse remain under review.
maintainerNotes: Keep Secretary of State contractor licensing separate from specialty boards and local licensing.

researchEvidence.note: Official Secretary of State contractor page reviewed; it states that anyone doing work above the $4,000 job threshold must be licensed as a contractor in North Dakota and links the registered contractor search.
Official FirstStop contractor search reviewed as the manual lookup path for registered North Dakota contractors.

blocker.summary: The official path requires or may require protected interactive access; OpenTrade Registry will not bypass technical controls.
